name: Canny Effort
body:
School divination; Level bard 0, cleric/oracle 0, druid 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration see text

DESCRIPTION

Your next single skill check (if it is made before the end of the next round) gains a +2 insight bonus.
